competences: The learner recalls the importance of teamwork in Christian life.
The learner explains ways Christians cooperate to meet community needs.
languageCompetence: Learners pronounce, read and spell cooperation, teamwork, voluntary, charity and unselfishness.
objectives: By the end of the period, learners should recall at least three reasons for working together.
By the end of the period, learners should explain four ways of cooperation and name two Christian organisations.
priorKnowledge: Learners studied the importance of working together on Tuesday and ways of cooperation on Thursday.
materials: Primary Six CRE reference exercises and class notes
references: P.6 C.R.E TERM III LESSON NOTES, 2022

steps.teacherActivity: The teacher recalls the two lessons of this week and asks "Why do we need to co-operate with each other?". They explain that learners are reviewing the value and methods of Christian cooperation in the world.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners recall the meaning of cooperation and identify important points already learned in the previous two lessons.

steps.content: Cooperation means working towards a common goal. Teamwork helps people overcome problems. Cooperation builds strength in a community. Working with others brings new ideas. Teamwork is useful for shared development projects. Unselfish people consider the welfare of others. Generosity and kindness support good relationships. Jesus cared for the sick and hungry. Jesus comforted people in sorrow. Cooperation encourages peace and freedom for all.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher revisits why Christians work together and displays the source points, including "Cooperation means working towards a common goal. Teamwork helps people overcome problems." They ask "5. Give two ways how you can care for the needy in your community" to check understanding of unselfish service.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read and explain the importance of working together, describe unselfishness and copy corrected review points.

steps.content: People cooperate by working together in teams. Good leadership encourages people to cooperate. Democratic rules can support cooperation. Caring for God's creation builds responsibility. People help the world by caring for others. Voluntary organisations provide services to needy people. The Bible Society spreads the Word of God. World Vision International supports community projects. Christian Children's Fund sponsors needy children. Christians show concern for other people's welfare.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher writes the key ways Christians cooperate and reviews community organisations, including "People cooperate by working together in teams. Good leadership encourages people to cooperate." They ask "6. State any two organization that help people in need" and correct the learners' explanations.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners name ways of cooperation, identify Christian organisations and answer the relevant sourced questions.

steps.content: Why do we need to co-operate with each other? | 5. Give two ways how you can care for the needy in your community | 6. State any two organization that help people in need | Why do we need Christian voluntary organization? | 1. What are voluntary organizations? | How can one use his/ her talents to benefit the world? | b) In which two ways did Jesus respond to the needs of people?
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher writes the seven original source questions, beginning with "Why do we need to co-operate with each other?" and "Why do we need Christian voluntary organization?". They supervise answers, mark the work and correct misconceptions using the written notes.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners answer the week-review questions independently, compare the written answers with their notes and correct errors.

steps.teacherActivity: The teacher checks revision using the source questions "1. What are voluntary organizations?" and "b) In which two ways did Jesus respond to the needs of people?". They summarise the two themes and assign remaining questions for additional practice.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners give final oral responses, record correct explanations of cooperation and note the homework for revision.

assessment: Assess responses to "Why do we need to co-operate with each other?", "6. State any two organization that help people in need", and "Why do we need Christian voluntary organization?". Mark answers and correct them with the source material.
homework: Revise the week and answer the original question "b) In which two ways did Jesus respond to the needs of people?"
